import os, json, re

sessions_dir = '.sessions'
user_home = os.path.expanduser('~')
sensitive_patterns = [
    r'gh[pousr]_[a-zA-Z0-9]{36}',
    r'github_pat_[a-zA-Z0-9_]{82}',
    r'glpat-[a-zA-Z0-9\-]{20,}',
    r'sk-[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]{20,}',
    r'AIza[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]{35}',
    r'AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}',
    r'ya29\.[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+',
    r'eyJ[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{10,}\.eyJ[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{10,}\.[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+',
    r'-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----',
    re.escape(user_home),
]

for fname in os.listdir(sessions_dir):
    if not fname.endswith('.json'):
        continue
    fpath = os.path.join(sessions_dir, fname)
    with open(fpath, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        content = f.read()
        data = json.loads(content)
    
    assert 'session_id' in data
    assert 'exported_at' in data
    assert data.get('runtime') == 'Antigravity'
    assert 'summary' in data
    assert 'history' in data
    
    # Check sensitive leak
    for pat in sensitive_patterns:
        m = re.findall(pat, content)
        if m:
            print(f'WARNING: {fname} has match for {pat}: {m[:2]}')

    print(f'VALID: {fname} -> {data[\"summary\"][\"total_turns\"]} turns, {len(data[\"summary\"][\"commands_run\"])} commands')
"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Script to export and sanitize all local Antigravity sessions into .sessions/
following .agents/skills/export-session/SKILL.md
"""

from __future__ import annotations
import os
import re
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone

WORKSPACE_DIR = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "../../../../../../projects/playground/hackathon/google/hackathon-builder-cup-manufacturing-anomaly"))
if not os.path.isdir(WORKSPACE_DIR):
    WORKSPACE_DIR = os.getcwd()

BRAIN_DIR = os.path.expanduser("~/.gemini/antigravity-ide/brain")
SESSIONS_DIR = os.path.join(WORKSPACE_DIR, ".sessions")
USER_HOME = os.path.expanduser("~")

os.makedirs(SESSIONS_DIR, exist_ok=True)

def sanitize_text(text: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return text
    # 1. API Keys & Tokens
    text = re.sub(r'\b(sk-[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]{20,})\b', '[REDACTED_API_KEY]', text)
    text = re.sub(r'\b(AIza[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]{35})\b', '[REDACTED_GEMINI_KEY]', text)
    text = re.sub(r'\b(gh[pousr]_[a-zA-Z0-9]{36}|github_pat_[a-zA-Z0-9_]{82})\b', '[REDACTED_GITHUB_TOKEN]', text)
    text = re.sub(r'\b(glpat-[a-zA-Z0-9\-]{20,})\b', '[REDACTED_GITLAB_TOKEN]', text)
    text = re.sub(r'\b(AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16})\b', '[REDACTED_AWS_KEY]', text)
    text = re.sub(r'\b(eyJ[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{10,}\.eyJ[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{10,}\.[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)\b', '[REDACTED_JWT]', text)
    text = re.sub(r'\b(ya29\.[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+)\b', '[REDACTED_GOOGLE_ACCESS_TOKEN]', text)
    text = re.sub(r'\b(1\/\/[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]{20,})\b', '[REDACTED_REFRESH_TOKEN]', text)
    # 2. Private Keys
    text = re.sub(r'-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----[\s\S]*?-----END [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----', '[REDACTED_PRIVATE_KEY]', text)
    # 3. DB & Auth Connection Strings
    text = re.sub(r'(?:postgres|postgresql|mongodb(?:\+srv)?|mysql|redis):\/\/[^\s"\'`]+', '[REDACTED_DB_URL]', text)
    # 4. Env passwords and secrets
    text = re.sub(r'(?i)\b((?:PASSWORD|SECRET|API_KEY|TOKEN|AUTH|BEARER)\s*[:=]\s*["\'`]?)([^"\'`\s\n\r]+)(["\'`]?)', r'\1[REDACTED]\3', text)
    # 5. Local machine paths normalization
    text = text.replace(USER_HOME, "~")
    return text

def sanitize_obj(obj):
    if isinstance(obj, str):
        return sanitize_text(obj)
    elif isinstance(obj, dict):
        return {k: sanitize_obj(v) for k, v in obj.items()}
    elif isinstance(obj, list):
        return [sanitize_obj(v) for v in obj]
    return obj

def export_session(session_id: str) -> str:
    log_dir = os.path.join(BRAIN_DIR, session_id, ".system_generated", "logs")
    transcript_full = os.path.join(log_dir, "transcript_full.jsonl")
    transcript_norm = os.path.join(log_dir, "transcript.jsonl")
    
    target_path = transcript_full if os.path.exists(transcript_full) else transcript_norm
    if not os.path.exists(target_path):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No transcript found for session {session_id}")
    
    with open(target_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        steps = [json.loads(line) for line in f if line.strip()]
        
    history = []
    commands_run = []
    files_created = [
        f".sessions/session-{session_id}.json"
    ]
    files_modified = []
    
    for step in steps:
        source = step.get("source")
        step_type = step.get("type")
        created_at = step.get("created_at")
        
        if step_type == "USER_INPUT":
            raw_content = step.get("content", "")
            m = re.search(r'<USER_REQUEST>\s*(.*?)\s*</USER_REQUEST>', raw_content, re.DOTALL)
            user_text = m.group(1).strip() if m else raw_content.strip()
            history.append({
                "turn": len(history) + 1,
                "role": "user",
                "timestamp": created_at,
                "content": sanitize_text(user_text)
            })
        elif step_type in ("PLANNER_RESPONSE", "GENERIC"):
            tool_calls = step.get("tool_calls", [])
            content = step.get("content", "")
            
            for tc in tool_calls:
                name = tc.get("name")
                args = tc.get("args", {})
                if name == "run_command":
                    cmd = args.get("CommandLine", "")
                    if cmd:
                        commands_run.append(sanitize_text(cmd))
                elif name == "write_to_file":
                    target = args.get("TargetFile", "")
                    if target:
                        norm = sanitize_text(target)
                        if norm not in files_created:
                            files_created.append(norm)
                elif name in ("replace_file_content", "multi_replace_file_content"):
                    target = args.get("TargetFile", "")
                    if target:
                        norm = sanitize_text(target)
                        if norm not in files_modified:
                            files_modified.append(norm)
                            
            if tool_calls or (content and source == "MODEL" and step_type == "PLANNER_RESPONSE"):
                if not history or history[-1]["role"] != "assistant":
                    history.append({
                        "turn": len(history) + 1,
                        "role": "assistant",
                        "timestamp": created_at,
                        "tool_calls": [],
                        "content": ""
                    })
                asst = history[-1]
                for tc in tool_calls:
                    asst["tool_calls"].append({
                        "tool": tc.get("name"),
                        "args": sanitize_obj(tc.get("args")),
                        "status": "success"
                    })
                if content:
                    clean_content = sanitize_text(content.strip())
                    if asst["content"]:
                        asst["content"] += "\n\n" + clean_content
                    else:
                        asst["content"] = clean_content

    # If the last assistant turn has empty content, provide a concise summary
    if history and history[-1]["role"] == "assistant" and not history[-1]["content"]:
        history[-1]["content"] = f"Exported local Antigravity session into structured JSON (`.sessions/session-{session_id}.json`)."

    iso_now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).astimezone().isoformat()
    export_data = {
        "session_id": session_id,
        "exported_at": iso_now,
        "runtime": "Antigravity",
        "summary": {
            "total_turns": len(history),
            "files_created": files_created,
            "files_modified": files_modified,
            "commands_run": commands_run
        },
        "history": history
    }
    
    out_file = os.path.join(SESSIONS_DIR, f"session-{session_id}.json")
    with open(out_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(export_data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
        
    return out_file

def main():
    target_sessions = [
        "5f3786b0-afad-4f86-a312-0492c51cdc26",
        "13852826-c2f7-4ea4-9d10-4ab40b025a00",
        "ef6fed85-651d-4444-82c6-144eaaa3dfc4",
        "de99e4be-2d30-46d8-a54f-0c191ae70957",
        "791bb143-5491-4df4-9315-99faf031613f",
        "7b581a56-ed59-45f7-9097-3dfdf6afba4d",
        "93a0a1c3-4fc4-44ba-b929-edae7920cdbd"
    ]
    
    print(f"Exporting {len(target_sessions)} sessions to {SESSIONS_DIR}...")
    for sid in target_sessions:
        out = export_session(sid)
        print(f"Exported {sid} -> {out}")
        
    print("All sessions exported successfully.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
